title: Bioluminescent Odonata Dragonfly
subtitle: Counter-Phase 4-Wing Flight & Slender Abdomen
description: High-agility Odonata flight simulation featuring four independently counter-phase flapping wings (90° lag), slender 10-segmented glowing abdomen, pterostigma leading-edge markers, and ambient water ripples.
mathNotation: z_{\text{fore}}(t) = A_1 \sin(\omega t), \quad z_{\text{hind}}(t) = A_2 \sin\left(\omega t - \frac{\pi}{2}\right), \quad S_k = S_0 + k \cdot \Delta y
formulaCompact: forewing = sin(8t),  hindwing = sin(8t - π/2),  abdomen = 10_segments
